QuestInfo.name: Dimensional Schism
QuestInfo.0: You met #p1103006# in #m270000100#.Find out what she knows about the mission.
QuestInfo.1: You must investigate the #m270000000# region and find the secret passage that connects to the Dimensional Schism. Arkarium must be stopped.
QuestInfo.2: You told #p1103006# where to find the  secret passage to Arkarium's Altar.

0.0: Oh, sorry. I'm laying my problems on you. Let me get to the point. See, another crack has opened up in the Temple of Time! I don't want to be presumptuous, but I think that's kind of bad.
0.1: I was snooping around in there and I think maybe I had gone into the past. It's not a big deal, but then I accidentally stumbled on to the entrance to an altar! You know who was in there? I bet you already do, but it was really scary to me...
0.2: It was Arkarium! I might have even seen Rhinne, the Goddess of Time! I'm not sure. My glasses aren't so good and then some monsters saw my hat poking out from behind a pillar and they chased me off.
0.3: So, since you're a big brave adventurer, I think your job is to go into the secret passage and see what Arkarium is up to! I mean, if you don't mind. I don't mean to tell you what to do with your time...

yes.0: When I was getting chased out, I saw a place with three doors. At least, I think it was. I was really scared and my glasses were all fogged up, but there may have been a fountain, or a statue, or somebody standing very still? Does that help?

no.0: Did I come off as too pushy? I just can't tell sometimes. I'm so sorry.

1.0: Did you find the secret passage into the Dimensional Schism by the statue-fountain?

yes.0: Ah, that's where it was! Now I remember... I think.

default.0: There just HAS to be a Dimensional Schism! I just know there is! Would you have time to check again?
